decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham sits at the core of the firm's announced organic expansion, so commitment to the organic line justifies keeping it despite the lack of recent evidence.
Organic Kasseler is part of the publicly promoted organic range and uses existing facilities, so management will attribute any weak sales to temporary causes and persist.
Organic pepper salami fits the strategic organic direction and the firm's salami competence, which encourages continued commitment.
The exotic teriyaki aspic is a niche deli counter item that is less central to the firm's direction, but its visible creation story and craft investment favor keeping it a while longer.
The fennel salami received a dedicated page, a visible commitment that management would want to justify, so it is likely retained.
The classic veal liver pâté is close to the traditional core range and fits the firm's heritage positioning, so it is likely kept.
